verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own docs claim log correlation with traces and metrics, and log-to-trace correlation is repeated in the Cloud docs. It also has a per-request span flamegraph, so the core of end-to-end debugging is present. However, no evidence shows a documented jump from a specific span to its logs or metrics; the documented drill-down starts from dashboard panels, not spans. Missing for 10: a documented span-to-logs navigation, a documented span-to-metrics navigation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the correlation workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Correlate logs with traces and metrics for faster root-cause analysis.
Query logs with blazing fast search and correlate them with traces.
Follow a single request across all microservices with a [flamegraph view](https://signoz.io/docs/userguide/span-details/) that shows every span, its duration, and parent-child relationships.
SigNoz also derives APM metrics from traces automatically.
